effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] Trash 1 card in your hand. Then, you may play 1 purple level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash without paying its memory cost.
 [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you trash a card in your hand using one of your effects, this Digimon gets +2000 DP and ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
